results.title: Droupadi Murmu becomes first President to address Odisha Assembly - The Hindu
results.label: yes
results.reason: constitutional_authority/state: First President to address Odisha Assembly; historical first for constitutional office.

notes.subject: polity
notes.why_in_news: President Droupadi Murmu became the first President of India to address the Odisha Legislative Assembly, returning to the house where she began her legislative career in 2000.
notes.fact_box: She was the first woman MLA from Odisha to be adjudged the best legislator in 2007.

prelims_pointers.text: President Murmu began her legislative career in 2000
The Subhadra scheme is a state initiative for women's empowerment in Odisha
Odisha provides an additional Rs. 800 per quintal as an input subsidy over and above the MSP for paddy

notes.mains_question: Discuss the significance of the President's role in fostering federal cooperation and the importance of legislative dignity in state assemblies.
mains_dimensions: Federal cooperation: Strengthening the bond between the Union Executive and State Legislatures
Legislative decorum: Impact of online broadcasting on maintaining dignity and public accountability in house proceedings

results.title: Manipur's violence-hit people, seeking to return home, clash with security forces - The Hindu
results.label: yes
results.reason: internal_security/national: Ongoing ethnic violence and security situation in Manipur.

notes.subject: security
notes.why_in_news: Displaced people in Manipur clashed with security forces in Imphal East district while attempting to return to their homes in Senapati district.
notes.fact_box: Hundreds of internally displaced persons (IDPs) were stopped by security forces at Yaingangpokpi on November 29, 2025. The clash occurred as people attempted to reach Gwaltabi, located on the periphery of the Senapati district, following ethnic violence that began in May 2023.

prelims_pointers.text: Imphal East district: Location of the clash between IDPs and security forces.
Senapati district: Location of the homes toward which displaced people were marching.
May 2023: Month when ethnic violence first broke out in Manipur.
November 21: Date the Sangai Festival began, coinciding with a period of heightened tension.

notes.mains_question: Analyze the challenges in managing internal displacement and restoring communal harmony in conflict-affected regions like Manipur.
mains_dimensions: Security-Human Rights Paradox: Balancing the need for public order with the right of IDPs to return to homes.
Institutional Friction: Discrepancy between official declarations of 'normalcy' and the ground reality of restricted movement.
Logistical Bottlenecks: Inadequate infrastructure and security protocols for the safe repatriation of displaced populations.
